purpose: External simplifier calibration on expressions extracted from six existing SHA binaries; not a new obfuscator
selection: For each binary: pure i32 local/constant expression trees, 1..8 operators, at most two locals; normalize local names by first occurrence; deduplicate; select first four by descending operator count then lexical expression
metric: Equivalent returned expression with fewer AST operators, plus errors/unsupported/timeout separately
validation: 49 boundary points plus 256 seeded random points per returned expression; finite testing only
